objective: Από τον κατάλογο templates, ξεχώρισε όσα ΤΑΙΡΙΑΖΟΥΝ σε οδοντιατρείο/ιατρείο/κλινική. Κρίνε ΜΟΝΟ την καταλληλότητα σχεδίου και το αν είναι customer-facing site. ΜΗΝ απορρίπτεις για άδεια: η άδεια ΔΕΝ φαίνεται σε σελίδα καταλόγου και επαληθεύεται χωριστά στο repo. Σημείωσε 'license: unknown-from-listing'. Απόρριψε μόνο ό,τι είναι σαφώς άσχετο (blog, e-commerce, portfolio, app/dashboard).

findings.name: Agen Bootstrap
findings.purpose: A clean, customer-facing agency/business template with sections for services, team, and contact.
findings.why_relevant: Its general business layout can be adapted for a clinic by repurposing services, team, and contact sections, though it lacks medical-specific features like appointments or department listings.
findings.pass1_reason: Agency template, καθαρό αλλά όχι ιατρικό.
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Agico Bootstrap
findings.purpose: Multipurpose Bootstrap landing page template that can be adapted for a medical or dental practice website.
findings.why_relevant: The template is customer-facing and flexible enough to present clinic services, appointments, and contact information after customization. Not medical-specific, so requires adaptation.
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Airspace Bootstrap
findings.purpose: Business/company website template with typical sections for services, about, team, pricing, and contact.
findings.why_relevant: Clean, professional design suitable for a medical or dental clinic; can be customized to present services, doctor profiles, opening hours, and location map.
findings.pass1_reason: Καθαρό business template, ιδανικό για κλινική.
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Bexer Bootstrap
findings.purpose: Business/services template suitable for appointment-based businesses.
findings.why_relevant: Fits dental/medical clinic as a customer-facing site with services and appointment booking.
findings.pass1_reason: Business template, κατάλληλο για υπηρεσίες και ραντεβού.
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Bingo Bootstrap
findings.purpose: Business template suitable for small business websites
findings.why_relevant: Business template, simple and clean, fits customer-facing clinic site; license unknown-from-listing
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against

findings.name: Bizcraft Bootstrap
findings.purpose: Business/company website template for professional services.
findings.why_relevant: Can be adapted for a medical/dental practice as a customer-facing site with service listings, contact, and appointment info.
findings.pass1_reason: Business template, ταιριάζει σε ιατρικές υπηρεσίες.
